text:
maya: saw a regression on canary: loader attempted mmap on a safetensors shard but blob was zstd-compressed by proxy, crashed with header mismatch.
jon: was there any sidecar/index present? we usually rely on chunk maps for mmap workloads.
maya: no sidecar. uploader pipeline introduced transparent compression at CDN layer. runtime had no signal and assumed raw offsets.
sasha: reminds me we need explicit artifact introspection. blindly mmaping is brittle with middleboxes.
kevin: proposal: add a lightweight capability manifest colocated with the blob (name.blob.caps.json). schema: {version:int, compression: "none|gzip|zstd|transparent", range_decompress: bool, index_version: int, signature_state: "verified|absent|delegated", prefetch_priority: "none|low|high"}. runtime uses this to pick path.
oliver: we should make capability fetch async and non-blocking: kick a caps read in parallel, but do optimistic mmap try. if mmap validation fails, consult caps (or retry) and failover to stream-first without failing load.
jon: tradeoffs: extra metadata GET per new artifact -> coldstart p99 impact. mitigate by cache keyed by artifact ETag and model hash, TTL 12-24h.
sasha: also add a probe result that encodes whether remote supports server-side range-decompress so runtime knows if streaming with range+inflate will be efficient. some CDNs provide that.
kevin: security: do not treat caps as authoritative for mmap offsets until binary signature verified. caps is advisory; the runtime must verify signature before using offsets for direct mmap. signature can be in sidecar or catalog; caps should point to signature_location.
maya: loader API change request: BlobLocator.resolve_tensor(tensor_name) -> union {mmap_descriptor: "path,offset,len,fd_hint", segments: [{blob, off, len, compressed}], fallback_signal}. keep serialization compact.
jon: add metrics: caps_fetches, caps_cache_hit, optimistic_mmap_success, mmap_validation_fail, fallback_stream_count, wasted_prefetch_bytes.
oliver: QA plan: upload a mix of artifacts: raw, gzipped, zstd, with/without sidecars, and run concurrent hotstart stress. add a chaos test where CDN toggles transparent compression mid-ingest.
sasha: dev task: extend uploader CLI to optionally emit chunk_map + caps.json and update catalog writer to populate signature pointer.
kevin: ops: add alert if fallback_stream_count spikes above threshold (suggest 1% per model) and a runbook entry "compression handshake mismatch" with remediation steps.
maya: feature flag REDWOOD_CAPS_PROBE=canary to gate rollout. also an env REDWOOD_OPTIMISTIC_MMAP=true to test optimistic path.
jon: small edge-case: proxies that rewrite ETag will bust cache key. fallback to artifact size+crc heuristic if ETag missing. document this in RFC.
sasha: testing: add fuzz harness truncating headers and injecting random compression markers to ensure loader never segfaults.
kevin: I'll add the alert and runbook. oliver can update uploader. maya, can you draft the RFC with caps schema, resolver contract, metrics, and migration checklist?
maya: on it. dev-bot: RFC created: /r/capability-manifest-for-blobs (linked in #eng-ml). :white_check_mark:
maya: will post the RFC link and a short migration checklist here once ready.
